disclaimer: Indicative eligibility only. Criteria are simplified and may change; always confirm on the official portal before applying.

schemes.name: Sumbangan Tunai Rahmah (STR)
schemes.summary: Cash assistance for low-income households, senior citizens and singles.
schemes.benefit: Up to RM2,500/year for households; RM600/year for singles (tiered by income)

schemes.name: Sumbangan Asas Rahmah (SARA)
schemes.summary: Monthly MyKad credit for basic necessities at participating stores.
schemes.benefit: Monthly credit on MyKad for essentials (rice, eggs, medicine, etc.)

schemes.name: eBelia Rahmah
schemes.summary: One-off e-wallet credit for youths and full-time students.

schemes.name: Bantuan Warga Emas (JKM)
schemes.summary: Monthly allowance for low-income senior citizens without family support.
documents: Proof of income (or declaration of no income)
Utility bill as proof of address

schemes.name: Bantuan Kanak-Kanak (JKM)
schemes.summary: Monthly support for low-income families with children under 18.
schemes.benefit: RM150-RM200 per child, up to RM1,000/month

schemes.name: Skim Perubatan MADANI
schemes.summary: Free basic outpatient treatment at participating private GP clinics for B40.
schemes.benefit: Up to RM60 per visit at panel clinics

schemes.name: eKasih / MyKasih
schemes.summary: National poverty database that unlocks food aid and other targeted assistance.
schemes.benefit: Monthly food aid credit and priority for other schemes

schemes.name: Bantuan Zakat (Asnaf)
schemes.summary: Monthly or one-off aid for Muslims below the state 'had kifayah' threshold.
schemes.benefit: Varies by state: monthly cash, education, medical and housing aid

schemes.name: PTPTN Repayment Assistance
schemes.summary: Repayment discounts and exemption for first-class graduates from low-income families.
schemes.benefit: Repayment discounts; full exemption for eligible first-class graduates
